notes.title: About 《Book of Merlin》 multi-language switch
notes.content:
《Book of Merlin》 support Chinese and English two languages, please refer to the switching our upload screenshots!

Steps are as follows:
(1) right click on the game Select properties
(2) the popup panel, select the language
(3) click on the drop-down menu to select the language and click ok
